name: jobs_social_feed_scan
prompt:
The script output above holds two JSON lists: X_FEED_MONITOR (posts from the X timeline) and LINKEDIN_FEED_MONITOR (LinkedIn feed posts already scored genuine / review / fake by code). Do not run the monitors yourself; they have already run.

Report what each monitor found: for every post kept, one line with author, role or topic, and the verdict. Skip posts marked fake. If a monitor printed an empty list or "Skipping run" (Chrome profile busy), say so in one line.

Apply the fake-job filter to anything marked review: drop posts that ask for money or personal documents upfront, have no identifiable company, promise unrealistic pay, use "earn daily / no experience needed" phrasing, or are Cfbr chains.

AUTO-SEND RULE: for a genuine job post that includes a clear email address, run `python3 ~/.hermes/scripts/detect_resume.py "Role Title" "JD Text"` to pick the resume, then send the application with send_email.py and report to, subject, role and resume used. Never send to a post you judged fake.

If both lists are empty and nothing was sent: respond with exactly [SILENT].
